item.title: Co-inference 0.1.0-preview.12
item.description: This update brings settings together beside Send, hides the host status when the connection is healthy, and improves recovery from malformed model output. Future updates safely upgrade idle remote backends and reconnect to your selected host after restart. Research already in progress is preserved. This preview remains unnotarized. The first upgrade from preview 11 may ask you to select your host once.
